speech.jaymoskingdoms.slave.squeak_2: Me not a toofpick! Me a goblin!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.slave.run_1: Dey not lookin... run run run!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.slave.run_2: No more chains! Me find free goblins!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.slave.freed_0: Free! Me free! Shiny friend, you da best!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.slave.freed_1: Me owe you! Me tell all da goblins!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.slave.freed_2: Quick quick, before big green ones come!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.slave.freed_3: Thankee thankee! Me gonna run so fast!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.slave.join_0: Me here! Me want in! Me work hard, no chains!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.slave.join_1: Goblins! Me escaped da orcs! Got any food?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.slave.join_2: Home at last! Me tell you stories bout da orcs!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.praise_the_sun.1: Praise the sun! It rises again!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.pirate.cry_4: Take the gold, sink the rest!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.strafe_0: Can't get a bead on him from here. Moving!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.strafe_1: He keeps dodging. Let me shift.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.strafe_3: Missing every time. Changing my footing.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.seek_sight_: I've no clear shot. Finding a better spot.
Wall's in the way. I'll find a window!
Can't see him. Getting a line.
Hold on, I need a clear view.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.close_in_0: Too far to hit anything. Closing in!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.close_in_1: Getting closer. These shots are wasted.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.close_in_3: Forward! I can't hit him from here.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.back_off_1: Backing off for a proper shot.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.flank_1: I'll come at him from the flank.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.cover_1: Wait in the shadows. Then strike.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.cover_3: Down. Let him wonder where I went.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.follow: Follow me. I'll take you to the %s.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.here: The %s is right there. Speak your piece.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.keep_up: Keep up. The %s won't wait all day.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.busy: Not now. Ask another of us.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.banned: You were thrown out of here. The %s won't see you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.refused: The %s has no time for the likes of you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.away: The %s isn't holding court just now.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.asleep: The %s is asleep. Come back in the morning.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.point: I can't get through. The %s is just there, go on ahead. You're expected.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.receive.t: Kneel, %s, and be quick about it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.receive.n: Welcome, %s. What can I do for you?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.receive.w: %s. Speak plainly, I've a war to run.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.receive.p: Stay where you are, %s. What do you want?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.receive.r: %s! Come in, come in! What's the news?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.receive.p: Well, %s. Say what you came to say.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stare.captain.0: She's yours! I'll not die for her!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stare.captain_hold: You'll take her over my body.
I've a crew at my back. Look elsewhere.
Stare all you like. She's mine.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stare.outlaw.1: Don't kill me. I'll come quietly.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stare.outlaw.2: Take me in, then. Just stop looking at me like that.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stare.yields.0: Take it. Take the crown. I never wanted it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stare.yields.1: There's nothing in the coffers worth dying for. The seat is yours.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stare.yields.2: I yield. Let me keep the hall for you, at least.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stare.tribute.1: Gold settles most quarrels. Let it settle this one.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stare.tribute.2: Pay them! Pay them and get them out of my hall!
You forget whose hall you stand in.
Is that meant to frighten me?
Glare all you like. I have seen worse than you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.learner.0: I've seen worse. I'm better for it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.learner.1: I'm getting the hang of this.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.drifter.pitch.0: Spare %s silver? I'll fight for you. Hold them out.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.drifter.pitch.1: Work's thin. %s silver and my sword is yours.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.drifter.pitch.2: Hire me for %s silver. I'm worth more than I look.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.drifter.short: I can't work for less than %s.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.drifter.hired.2: A hot meal and a fight. Fair enough.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.haven_gate.halt.0: Stop there, human. This isn't your road.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.haven_gate.halt.1: No further. Turn round and walk back the way you came.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.haven_gate.halt.2: Hold! Your kind waits outside. Go.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.haven_gate.shove.0: I said out. Next time it won't be my hand.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.haven_gate.shove.1: Out, and don't come back without a friend of ours beside you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.clash.taken.0: They took %s! They took my little one!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.clash.taken.1: %s is gone! The raiders carried them off!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ignis.sibling: Sibling of the flame. Sit by my fire; let us temper what you carry.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ignis.stranger: You followed the smiths' gossip all the way down here? Then you've earned a look at my anvil.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.wayfinder.price: A wayfinder costs %s, friend. The charcoal alone is dear.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.wayfinder.sold: Here. Up here it shows where to open your gate; down there it finds him.
To me! They've struck one of ours!
Sworn to the haven, every one of us. Hold the line!
Blow the horn! No one walks away from this!
Shoulder to shoulder. We do not run.
I swore an oath. Your eyes don't unswear it.
Look all you like. I stand here.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.sermon.0: Hear me! There is one Truth, and it does not hide in stone and candle smoke.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.sermon.1: The seven are old fears given names. Leave their shrines to the moss.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.sermon.2: The hearth will not feed you and the anvil will not mend you. The Truth asks only honesty.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.sermon.3: They light candles to the Lantern Warden and still fear the dark. We walk in plain sight.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.sermon.4: The sun rises because it rises. It wants no praise from you!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.sermon.5: Swear to the seven and they own you. Leave them and they mark you. The Truth marks no one.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.sermon.shrine.0: Another altar to %s. Who keeps putting these up?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.sermon.shrine.1: This stone is %s's. It will not answer you, child.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.sermon.shrine.2: Pray to %s if you must. The Truth will still be here when it fails you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.sermon.apostate.0: You turned your back on the Truth. Everyone here will know it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.sermon.apostate.2: The Truth does not forget those who leave it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.sermon.home.0: Welcome home. The old one's omens will pass.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.sermon.home.1: The old one will chase you a while. Come to me if its omens grow heavy.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.sermon.home.2: You chose well. I can ease what follows you, if you ask.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.sermon.heathen.0: Sworn to %s, in our streets. Come and talk with me some day.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.sermon.heathen.2: You carry %s's mark. Put it down, and I will help you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.shun.1: That's the one who turned from the Truth.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.rite.done.0: Go in peace. The omens will follow you less, and not for long.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.rite.done.1: It is done. The mark stays: that is yours to carry.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.rite.home.0: Welcome back to the Truth. Let the old one rage.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.rite.home.1: It is done. Stand in plain sight, and its omens will fade.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.envoy.arrive.0: I come from %s with words for your crown.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.envoy.arrive.1: Word from %s, for whoever wears the crown here.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.envoy.arrive.2: I bear an offer from %s. Where is your sovereign?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.envoy.signed: My lord will be glad of it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.envoy.refused: So be it. I will tell %s.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.envoy.leave: I can wait no longer. I go home to %s.
